name: io.github.langmail/langmail-mcp
title: Langmail MCP for your own Stalwart
description: Email, calendar and contacts tools for your own Stalwart server, over JMAP and CalDAV.

environmentVariables.name: STALWART_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Stalwart server (e.g. https://mail.example.com)

environmentVariables.name: STALWART_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Account name to sign in with; use together with STALWART_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.name: STALWART_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token, as an alternative to STALWART_USERNAME and STALWART_PASSWORD
